name: Stamford Land Corporation Ltd
summary: Stamford Land Corporation Ltd, an investment holding company, owns, operates, and manages hotels in Singapore, Australia, and the United Kingdom. The company operates through Hotel Owning and Management, Property Development, Property Investment, Trading, and Others segments. It owns and operates hotels and resorts under the Stamford Plaza Sydney Airport, Stamford Plaza Melbourne, Stamford Grand Adelaide, Stamford Plaza Adelaide, and Stamford Plaza Brisbane names. The company also invests in, develops, constructs, rents, manages, and trades in real estate properties. In addition, it provides trustee, travel agency, and management services.
